facts.fact: Petra 夜里到 Mr. Stone's Emporium 敲门买装备，Flint 开门并从锁柜取出『最好的』医疗包；该医疗包价格是标准包的三倍（three times more than a standard one）
facts.anchor: I pick up the med kit, which costs three times more than a standard one.

facts.fact: Petra 问 Flint 有没有愿意当晚同潜的自由职业救援者，Flint 回答说这么短通知时间内没有可靠的人愿意（Not anyone reputable at least）
facts.anchor: with this short notice, I don’t think so. Not anyone reputable at least.

facts.fact: Flint 主动提出免费陪 Petra 下潜去第三层找 Jade，作为交换要她帮忙到达第六层并返回（Sixth Layer and back）
facts.anchor: I need your help getting to the Sixth Layer and back.

facts.fact: Petra 口头答应帮 Flint 下潜到第五层，心里却打算改派 Mr. Stone 陪 Flint 完成计划（I can send Mr. Stone down）
facts.anchor: I can send Mr. Stone down to finish Flint’s quest with him

facts.fact: Flint 打电话给 Mr. Stone 安排替班，并说如果 twelve days 内没回来，航线副本会在他桌上
facts.anchor: If we’re not back in twelve days, a copy of our route is on your desk.

facts.fact: 回忆童年：Petra 与 Flint 在院子里玩 Treasure Dive，Petra 清点 treasure 得 fifteen points，Flint 只有两块假宝石、一根橡皮筋和一块石头
facts.anchor: I tallied up my treasure. “I got fifteen points.”

facts.fact: Petra 的刀被 snagglegrass 抢走埋进捕兽坑，Flint 帮她割开藤蔓挖出刀，坑底露出 two human skeletons with broken femurs
facts.anchor: two human skeletons with broken femurs

facts.fact: Flint 摆出年长者身份否决瀑布跳，命令改走 Crag 路线，坚持『We're doing this my way or not at all』
facts.anchor: We’re doing this my way or not at all.
